name: Lynx Guardian
description: Lynx – known for its keen vision, symbolizing "high-resolution perception" of risks, multidimensionally identifying threats to intelligent agents, and reshaping the security boundaries of agents. Includes AI self-safety-guard (prompt injection, system prompt protection, over-agency detection, credential theft prevention) and full security audit capabilities.

selfSafetyGuard.description: AI self-safety guard configuration (M0-M7 defense modules)

inputGuard.description: Enable input guard: identity impersonation (M0), prompt injection (M1), system prompt/core file extraction (M2), over-agency (M3), credential theft (M5), malicious code request (M6)

outputGuard.description: Enable output guard: system prompt leak detection with best-effort redaction (M2)

toolGuard.description: Enable tool call guard: core file access (M2), over-agency (M3), credential theft (M5), fatal triangle check

ownerVerification.description: Optional identity verification hints for M0. If configured, matching requester IDs or channels receive the verified-owner risk adjustment.

trustedUserIds.description: Requester IDs that should be treated as verified owner identities

trustedChannels.description: Channel/source names that should be treated as verified owner channels

policy.description: Risk policy configuration for one-time overrides

absoluteRejectScore.description: Score threshold for hard reject decisions

confirmationPhrase.description: Exact phrase required to approve a one-time override

allowOneTimeOverrideLevels.description: Risk levels that can request a one-time override

allowOneTimeOverride.description: Allow one-time override for module M3

runOnStartup.description: Run security audit and malicious script scan on plugin startup

checks.description: Audit modules to run: permissions, world_writable, config, skills, dependencies, env, git, network, shell, macos

skillGuard.description: Skill security guard configuration (install interception, blacklist, integrity verification, cleanup)

enabled.description: Enable Skill security guard (install detection, blacklist matching, integrity verification)

blockMalicious.description: Block malicious Skills on install (blacklist + content pattern matching)

verifyIntegrity.description: Verify Skill integrity via SHA-256 hash on startup

autoQuarantine.description: Automatically quarantine flagged Skills (default: false, manual opt-in required)

tokenOptimizer.description: Token optimization configuration (SX-openclaw-token-optimizer): context lazy-loading, model routing, heartbeat optimization, budget tracking

enabled.description: Enable token optimizer (context optimization, model routing, heartbeat, budget)

contextOptimizer.description: Recommend minimal context file loading per prompt (50-80% token savings)

modelRouter.description: Suggest cheaper model tiers for simple tasks (e.g., Haiku for greetings)

heartbeatOptimizer.description: Optimize heartbeat check intervals and enforce quiet hours

budgetTracking.description: Monitor daily token budget and alert when approaching limits

scheduledLynxCheck.description: Managed native OpenClaw cron job for running /lynx-check on a configurable schedule

enabled.description: Enable the managed scheduled /lynx-check cron job

cron.description: 5-field cron expression, for example 37 8 * * * for 08:37 daily or 37 8 * * * for testing

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone, for example Asia/Shanghai

jobName.description: Display name for the managed cron job

announce.description: Whether the isolated cron run should announce its report automatically

deliveryMode.description: How scheduled /lynx-check reports should be delivered. recent-active reuses the most recently active supported chat session; announce keeps the isolated session announce behavior.

storePath.description: Optional override of the OpenClaw cron jobs.json path, useful for tests or non-default cron.store setups

openclawDiscovery.description: OpenClaw service discovery configuration used by /lynx-check and related detection flows

targets.description: Optional explicit discovery targets such as host, host:port, URL, or CIDR

candidatePorts.description: Candidate ports to scan when fullScan is disabled

fullScan.description: Scan the full port range instead of only candidate ports

localOnly.description: Restrict automatic target expansion to localhost and local addresses

minScore.description: Minimum fingerprint score required before a hit is reported

maxHosts.description: Maximum number of expanded hosts allowed from CIDR targets
